scope: Original twenty captured grocery profiles; batch comparison, not certification of current packages.
originalProviderSources: Open Food Facts contributors (ODbL), USDA FoodData Central (CC0), existing manufacturer-attributed Chobani catalog. Original archives unchanged.
methodology: Use original panels and existing approved energy-qualifier recovery. Compare only documented quantities. Do not mix label editions, infer density or treat bounds as exact.
implementedCorrections: OFF canonical _100g/_serving weight fields use schema grams; entered display units apply only to _value.
OFF canonical _100g/_serving energy alias uses kJ; entered energy units apply only to _value.
Entered energy-kcal_value honors its explicit unit and rejects unsupported units; canonical energy-kcal fields remain kcal.
The legacy Trace _100ml extension retains explicit-unit handling; its assessment capture agrees with logging and unknown generic energy units stay unknown.
finding: Neither shared defect is responsible for the suspicious original twenty values: archived weight units are already grams and energy uses explicit kcal. No additional exact-product overrides justified by matched editions. Original nutrition and overall integers unchanged.

source.attribution: Open Food Facts contributors; database licensed under ODbL

manufacturerComparison.finding: US 20 fl oz panel differs: 240 vs 250 kcal, 65 vs 63 g total sugar, 75 vs 20 mg sodium. Provider market is Guyana; added sugars contradict total sugars in assessment evidence. No US formulation substitution.

Available official text is the 12 fl oz can; selected observation is a 20 fl oz bottle. USDA serving unit mlt/reference dimension remains unresolved. Do not scale a different package or assume g/mL density.

products.name: Quest Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough Protein Bar

source.attribution: Open Food Facts contributors; database licensed under ODbL

manufacturerComparison.finding: Provider itself contains 0.00022 g sodium/serving, correctly converted by Trace to 0.22 mg. Manufacturer says 220 mg. Ingredients differ (protein order, water/chocolate/salt and other list details), markets mix France/US, manufacturer box variants share the listed barcode. Clear source discrepancy, not a Trace g-to-mg error; no unverified cross-edition correction.

manufacturerComparison.finding: Exact UPC manufacturer panel differs substantially: 770 mg sodium/56 g vs provider 1.36 mg/56.699 g, 16 vs 13.8 g fat, 6 vs about 5.5 g saturated fat, 7 vs 8.5 g protein. Provider raw sodium is 0.00136 g, not 1.36 g. Multiplying by 1000 would give 1360 mg, not this label. Mixed markets, different serving/panel/recipe; no safe blanket repair.

manufacturerComparison.finding: Exact UPC 8 oz/28 g panel agrees on calories, saturated fat, sodium, fiber and protein. Manufacturer total sugar is <1 g, not exact provider 1 g; added sugar is not significant, not an invented exact value. Do not replace with zero.

limitations: 17 manufacturer nutrient-panel comparisons, one secondary-only comparison, two incomplete exact-package comparisons; not 17 independently verified UPC/formulation matches.
Manufacturer bounds and source/edition conflicts remain explicit. No conditional manufacturer score is substituted for a captured product score.
No application storage, historical records, grading math, additive policy or runtime provider requests added. Existing Teddy correction remains separate and unchanged.
